verdict.rationale: Gecko is a code security scanner, so verifying detected secrets against the issuing service is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions secret detection or live-credential verification. The 'Fix verified' recheck (docs-4/16) confirms remediated vulnerabilities, and the GitLab token expiry check (docs-32) monitors Gecko's own integration token. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can have detected secrets verified against the issuing service so I know which ones are live
